correctness.raw_error_proof: abs(sum dropped Wq_j)<=sum exact beta<=sum conservative upper<=B

hardware_models.ideal_combinational_8r: One natural 8-active word per cycle, eight arbitrary 4-bit reads, an eight-lane combinational greedy chain, same-cycle bank routing and accept-before-issue with unbounded queues.
hardware_models.ideal_free_compaction: Maximum kept population among eight modulo banks, with all selection and repacking free. Opportunity only.
hardware_models.passthrough_no_repack: Read/gate only the source that the legacy K8 engine was already going to issue. Dropped lanes are bubbles and cannot be refilled; timeline is the B0 baseline plus metadata prefetch.
hardware_models.predesign_logic: Eight 4-bit-code decoders, eight dependent 11-bit add/compare/select lanes for B<=1024, per-bank lane counts, an 8x8 source-ID route/compactor, eight bank FIFOs, task/tag state and B0 bypass muxing. No timing or area is admitted without DC.
hardware_models.registered_d16_8r: Same as registered_d8_8r with depth 16 per bank.
hardware_models.registered_d8_8r: Eight arbitrary reads plus eight per-bank source-ID FIFOs of depth 8. An input word is accepted atomically after issue; capacity pressure stalls the held word.
hardware_models.registered_d8_banked1r: Eight source_id-modulo-8 single-read beta banks plus depth-8 per-bank source-ID FIFOs. Duplicate metadata-bank reads serialize before atomic word acceptance.
hardware_models.registered_infinite_8r: One 8-active word per cycle and eight arbitrary reads; old bank queues issue before the selected word is registered. Infinite queues expose only ordering/tail.

mechanism.b0: hard direct K8 bypass with zero metadata, gate, queue or compactor cycles
mechanism.encoding: smallest 4-bit code c whose U[c] is at least exact beta
mechanism.ordering: ascending natural source_id among the current task's active sources; no beta/code sorting
mechanism.raw_error_bound: for every destination j in the group, abs(sum dropped Wq_j)<=sum dropped exact beta<=sum dropped U<=B
mechanism.runtime_rule: maintain accumulated dropped conservative bound S; for each active source in natural order, drop and set S=S+U iff S+U<=B, otherwise keep that source and continue considering later sources
